name: pho2booth-workspace
description: Pho2Booth - Photo Booth Web App with Next.js Frontend and Neon Postgres Serverless Backend

scripts.dev:all: npm run dev --prefix frontend & npm run dev --prefix backend
scripts.test:library: npm run test:library --prefix backend && npm run test:library --prefix frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:guardrails && npm run test:library && npm run test:isolation && npm run test:billing && npm run test:motion && npm run test:auth --prefix frontend && npm run test:api --prefix frontend && npm run test:serverless --prefix frontend
